newsitem.title: USA: UStel Inc to take retroactive Q3 charge. [CORRECTED 17:05 GMT 1/1]
newsitem.headline: UStel Inc to take retroactive Q3 charge. [CORRECTED 17:05 GMT 1/1]

text.p: UStel Inc on Tuesday said it would take a non-cash charge of about $2.5 million retroactive to the third quarter of 1996.
UStel said in a statement it would file amended third-quarter results to reflect the charge. Results of prior quarters will be unaffected.

The company also said it appointed Jerry Dackerman as president and chief operating officer. Robert Diener, who had been acting as president since August 15, was elected chairman, replacing Royce Diener. Robert Diener (Corrects) will continue to serve as chief executive officer.
UStel offers long-distance telecommunications services for commercial, residential and specialty markets.
